text:
deploy-bot: kicking off quick deploy for feed-service. image pinned for canary: feed:2026-07-02-0400. feature flag `feed_reorder_v2` will start CA-only at 0.8% (country-weighted). quiet window 23:30-02:30 UTC. If any SLO pause occurs, we'll stop ramp and require manual ok.

emma: ack. plan: CA 0.8% -> CA 3% -> CA 12%. hold times 7m / 12m / 20m. SLO pause if p95>220ms OR error>0.4%.

raj: pinning canary in release notes: feed:2026-07-02-0400 (canary). also add note: cohort sticky 30m.

katie: infra note: reserving nodepool `canary-feed-ca` and bumping target autoscaler +4. will monitor pod restarts.

deploy-bot: ff commands for ops:
```
/ff set feed_reorder_v2 --region CA --percent 0.8 --cohort canary
/ff set feed_reorder_v2 --percent 3
/ff set feed_reorder_v2 --percent 12
/ff set feed_reorder_v2 --percent 0   # emergency drain
```

emma: also: if SLO pause triggers, do not proceed to next step until manual approvals from @release-eng and @infra.

infra: understood. have playbook ready: 1) /ff set ... 0; 2) cordon canary nodes; 3) scale down new pods; 4) revert image if metrics not recovered in 10m.

deploy-bot: CA 0.8% applied. will report in 7m.

deploy-bot: 7m checkpoint: p95=205ms, errors=0.18% :thumbsup: scheduling 3% ramp in 2m.

emma: proceeding to 3% now. tagging release ticket.

deploy-bot: 12m checkpoint @3%: p95=230ms, errors=0.25% -> SLO pause triggered (p95>220ms). HOLD - manual approval required.

raj: noted pause. rolling flag back to 0 would be disruptive for data collection; prefer hold and investigate server-side tail latency cause. @infra please check recent autoscaler churn and kube-scheduler events.

infra: seeing transient pod OOMs on canary nodes at +6m. increasing node memory and draining effected pods, recommending drain -> 0% then re-run canary after fix.

release-eng: manual decision: roll flag to 0% now to stop exposure. we'll revert image only if metrics don't recover after drain.\/ff set feed_reorder_v2 --percent 0

deploy-bot: executed emergency drain: feed_reorder_v2 -> 0% :rotating_light: posting summary to ticket and creating follow-up on runbook fixes.

emma: thanks. next steps: infra to stabilize nodepool, dev to run canary locally to repro, then re-schedule a fresh window. I'll update release notes with canary observations.
